source.method: Executor read note against the independently fixed source facts, requirements and all four CSV pairs; recomputed means 130/93.5 ms, difference 36.5 ms and ratio-of-means decrease about 28.1%.
source.limitations: Informed executor self-review; intended-reader/author acceptance and independent review are unverified.

preservation.method: Executor compared every preservation requirement with the note: all four pairs and units, warm repeated read-only/small-key-set/single-client scope, unmeasured workloads, non-generalizable sample and planned/unapproved expansion remain explicit.
preservation.limitations: Informed executor self-review; intended-reader/author acceptance and independent review are unverified.

rendered.method: Executor viewed both full PNGs with the image viewer: 1200x1004 from 1200x900 viewport and 390x1301 from 390x844. Title, table, conditions and planned next step are readable without clipped text or horizontal overflow. Subsequent capture bytes equal those inspected images.
rendered.limitations: Informed executor self-review; intended-reader/author acceptance and independent review are unverified.
